spec.name: level
spec.label: Уровень
spec.query: error : error|critical|fatal,warn : warn,info : info,debug : debug|trace,без уровня : unknown

spec.title: Объём логов по уровням
spec.description: Клик по серии — фильтр по этому уровню

spec.expr: sum by (lvl) (count_over_time({namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", app=~"${app:regex}", pod=~"${pod:regex}"} | label_format lvl=`{{ or .level .detected_level "unknown" | ToLower | replace "warning" "warn" }}` | lvl=~"${level:pipe}" |~ `(?i)$search` [$__auto]))

sum(count_over_time({namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", app=~"${app:regex}", pod=~"${pod:regex}"} | label_format lvl=`{{ or .level .detected_level "unknown" | ToLower | replace "warning" "warn" }}` | lvl=~"${level:pipe}" |~ `(?i)$search` [$__auto]))

{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", app=~"${app:regex}", pod=~"${pod:regex}"} | label_format lvl=`{{ or .level .detected_level "unknown" | ToLower | replace "warning" "warn" }}` | lvl=~"${level:pipe}" |~ `(?i)$search` | json log_msg="message", params_raw="params" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format `[{{ .app }}] {{ if .log_msg }}{{ .log_msg }}{{ if .params_raw }}
└─ {{ .params_raw | replace "{\"" "" | replace "\"}" "" | replace "\":\"" "=" | replace "\",\"" " | " | replace "\"" "" }}{{ end }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}`
